channel.title: Magick Mastery | The Magick Muse
channel.description: Free witchcraft guides and deep dives from The Magick Muse, sourced from the same published scholarship as the Magick Manuscript.

item.title: Astrology for Witches: Timing Spells by Moon & Planets
item.description: You don't need to read a birth chart to use astrology in your craft. Here's how witches work with the seven planets, the moon, and magickal timing.

item.title: Herbalism for Witches: Working With Plants Safely
item.description: Herbs are one of the oldest tools in the craft. Here's what plant magick actually is, where it comes from, and how to start working with herbs safely.

item.title: Runes for Beginners: How to Read the Elder Futhark
item.description: Runes aren't just an ancient alphabet. Here's what they actually are, where they come from, and how to start reading the Elder Futhark with respect.

item.title: Divination for Beginners: Tarot, Runes & Signs
item.description: Divination isn't the fortune-telling you see in movies. What it actually is, the main methods witches use, and how to choose the right one for you.

item.title: Witch Tools for Beginners: What You Need & Your First Altar
item.description: You don't need a room full of expensive tools to start practicing witchcraft. Here's what earns a spot in your kit and how to set up your first altar.

item.title: Ten Years a Witch: What I'd Tell My Beginner Self
item.description: Over a decade into practicing witchcraft, here's an honest look at what's shifted, what I've unlearned, and what I wish I could tell my beginner self.

item.title: How to Dispose of a Spell: Wax, Herbs & Spell Jars
item.description: Not sure what to do with leftover wax, herbs, and jars from your spellwork? A plain guide to ritual disposal and which method suits which working.

item.title: Ancestor Work for Beginners: Honoring Your Lineage
item.description: New to ancestor work? How to build a real relationship with your lineage, whether you know your family history or not, and why it grounds any practice.

item.title: Deity Work for Beginners: Approaching the Gods
item.description: New to deity work? How to approach gods and goddesses respectfully, build a real relationship over time, and avoid the most common beginner mistakes.

item.title: Working With the Greek Gods: Kharis & Offerings
item.description: A beginner's guide to Hellenic deity work: the Olympian gods, the concept of kharis, and building a reciprocal relationship the way the ancients did.

item.title: The Law of Similars: Why Like Affects Like in Magick
item.description: The Law of Similars is one of the oldest principles in magick. Here's what it means, how it works, and how to use it in your own spellwork.

item.title: How to Cast a Spell: Candles, Jars, Sachets & Sigils
item.description: What actually goes into a spell? This breaks down four different spell formats so you understand the structure and can choose what works for you.

item.title: Witchcraft Misinformation: How to Find Reliable Sources
item.description: The witchcraft corner of the internet is full of misinformation. Here's how to tell reliable sources from content that could harm your practice.

item.title: How to Research Witchcraft and Find Your Own Answers
item.description: Research isn't separate from witchcraft. It is witchcraft. Here's how to find your own answers and why it's one of the most important skills in the craft.

item.title: Meditation for Witches: A Beginner's Guide to Focus
item.description: Meditation for witches doesn't require an empty mind or an hour of silence. What it actually is, why it matters for spellwork, and how grounding fits in.

item.title: Protection Magick for Beginners: Shields, Wards & Banishing
item.description: Protection magick is where every practice should start. Learn the types of protection, when to use them, and how to build shields and wards that hold.

item.title: What Is a Correspondence in Witchcraft?
item.description: What does 'correspondence' mean in witchcraft? A simple explanation of the concept that holds all spellwork together, and how to use it.

item.title: Shadow Work for Witches: What It Is & How to Begin
item.description: Shadow work keeps coming up in witchcraft spaces for a reason. Here's what it actually is, why it matters, and how to start without overwhelming yourself.

item.title: Your First Tarot Deck: How to Choose, Cleanse & Read
item.description: Just got your first tarot deck? How to choose one, cleanse it, bond with it, and start reading, without the myths and overcomplicated rituals.

item.title: What to Put in a Grimoire: A Look Inside Mine
item.description: Not sure what goes in a grimoire? A breakdown of every section in The Magick Manuscript and why each one earns its place in a witchcraft reference.

item.title: Best Witchcraft Books for Beginners: A Reading List
item.description: Not all witchcraft books are created equal. A beginner reading list organized by topic, from the same books that built The Magick Manuscript.
